# iDataGear

> iDataGear Inc (Intelligence Data Gear) makes McLearn® language apps and everyday tools for iPhone, iPad, Android and the web, from Toronto and Hong Kong. Eight core apps: McChinese (Mandarin, HSK 1–6), McCantonese (spoken Cantonese with Jyutping), McEnglish (English, CEFR A1–C2; listed as ALL English on Google Play), the Great Cantonese Dictionary (71,655 entries, fully offline), Chinese Xie Zi (stroke-order writing), QuickOne Scanner (on-device PDF scanning and OCR), Momera GO (hike tracking and journey replay) and McMuse (photo to art in 51 styles).

Each app has a guide page with screenshots, walkthroughs, an FAQ and, for six apps, a promo video. Full details for every app are in [llms-full.txt](https://www.idatagear.com/llms-full.txt).

## Core apps

- [McChinese — Learn Chinese](https://www.idatagear.com/chinese/): Mandarin from the first character to HSK 6. About 7,000 words with pinyin and audio across HSK 1–6 and Grade 1–6, 1,988 example sentences, 33 graded articles, 309 reading test questions, four mini-games and animated stroke order. iPhone, iPad, Android and web.
- [McCantonese — Learn Cantonese](https://www.idatagear.com/cantonese/): Cantonese as spoken in Hong Kong and Guangzhou. Interactive Jyutping guide (19 initials, the finals, six tones), speaking practice with speech recognition, 12,116 Hong Kong slang entries, 3,146 phrases, 2,167 characters, 1,398 daily sentences, 209 dialogues and 274 mini stories, stored on the device. iPhone, iPad, Android and web.
- [McEnglish — ALL English](https://www.idatagear.com/english/): English by CEFR level, A1 to C2. 8,000+ words with IPA, collections (Basic 850, Oxford 3000, Common 2198, VOA 1510, IELTS, CET-4, CET-6), graded reading, timed level tests, speaking practice and two hands-free listening modes. iPhone, iPad, Android and web.
- [Great Cantonese Dictionary 粵語大詞典](https://www.idatagear.com/gcd/guide/): 71,655 Cantonese entries with Jyutping and pronunciation, searchable by characters, Jyutping, English or Mandarin, entirely offline. Gen Z slang, a seven-part Guangzhou dialect collection, reduplication, tongue twisters, children's songs, the Three Character Classic, a Jyutping guide and grammar. iPhone, iPad, Android and web.
- [Chinese Xie Zi 写字板](https://www.idatagear.com/xiezi/guide/): learn to write Chinese characters. Trace 9,500+ characters and radicals with real-time stroke feedback, animated stroke order, decomposition, Simplified and Traditional side by side, grouped by HSK 1–6, HSK 7–9 and radicals. iPhone, iPad, Android and web.
- [QuickOne Scanner: PDF & OCR](https://www.idatagear.com/quickonescanner/): a document scanner that runs entirely on the device. Edge detection, OCR for Latin scripts and Chinese, full-text search, tags and folders, signatures, and export as searchable PDF, JPEG, TXT or ZIP. Nothing is uploaded and there is no account. iPhone, iPad and Android.
- [Momera GO](https://www.idatagear.com/momerago/): record hikes with GPS that needs no signal, pin photos, videos, voice memos and notes to the route, build journeys from Google Timeline or photos, and replay them on the map. iPhone, iPad, Android and web. Guides also in [简体中文](https://www.idatagear.com/momerago/zh-cn.html) and [繁體中文](https://www.idatagear.com/momerago/zh-tw.html).
- [McMuse: Photo to Art](https://www.idatagear.com/mcmuse/): turns a photo into a new artwork in 51 styles (16 art styles such as oil, watercolour, anime and Chinese ink wash, plus 35 more). Several styles from one photo, 1K/2K/4K output, a gallery kept on the device. Rendering uses Google's Gemini after the user agrees; location data is stripped first. Android (Google Play).

## More apps

- [Eyeball It!](https://www.idatagear.com/eyeballit/): a visual-estimation puzzle game with length, liquid-volume and colour modes. iPhone, Android and web.
- [Momera.ME](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.momera): a private, offline journal by voice, text and photo. Android.
- [Open Interview](https://www.idatagear.com/interview/): AI-powered interview practice. Web.
- [Tic Tac Toe Toe](https://www.idatagear.com/tttt/): tic-tac-toe on a 4×4 board against an AI. Android and web.
- [Si Ding 四顶](https://www.idatagear.com/siding/): a traditional Chinese strategy board game. Android and web.
